payload.rebuttal: fixed: The declared witness for criterion 1 never drove `batch`, so this clause had no coverage. I added a step at the end of `test_a_cell_sent_sigterm_tears_down_and_closes_its_task` (not a new test function) that stubs `cli._batch` to record `signal.getsignal(signal.SIGTERM)`, calls `cli.main` with a `batch` argv, and asserts the recorded handler equals the one in place before the call. Verified by hand: applying the exact edit from this finding (`signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)` before `return _batch(...)`) now fails this assertion.
